name: transition_selected_object_to_opaque_base_color

stack.evidence: func_001D0C98 consumes one duration, queues a type-23 COLOR_CHANGE operation targeting the selected object's RGB bytes at offsets 0x370 through 0x372 with alpha 1.0, packs twice the duration into the operation, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: This specialized COLOR_CHANGE variant transitions to the selected object's base RGB rather than taking explicit color values as command 90 does. All 36 JP calls occur in pc01.ard copies during show-object setup, pass duration 12 or 16, and are followed by waits totaling that duration before command 90 restores full white.
